reference: At nine tonight he will be holding ice on that swelling again.
sk: Dnes o deviatej bude držať ľad na ten opuch.
cz: Dnes v devět bude držet led na ten otok.
acceptable: At nine {tonight|this evening|o'clock tonight|o'clock this evening} he will be holding ice {on|against|to} {that|the} swelling{ again|}.
{Tonight|This evening} at nine{ o'clock|} he will be holding ice {on|against|to} {that|the} swelling{ again|}.
He will be holding ice {on|against|to} {that|the} swelling{ again|} at nine {tonight|this evening|o'clock tonight}.
{Today at nine|At nine today} he will be holding ice {on|against|to} {that|the} swelling{ again|}.

mistakes.text: At nine tonight he will hold ice on {that|the} swelling{ again|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý bude v danom čase práve prebiehať, vyjadruje Future Continuous: „will be holding“, nie „will hold“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který bude v danou dobu právě probíhat, vyjadřuje Future Continuous: „will be holding“, ne „will hold“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action in progress at a set future time needs Future Continuous: “will be holding”, not “will hold”.

mistakes.text: At nine tonight he {holds|is holding} ice on {that|the} swelling{ again|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý bude v danom čase práve prebiehať, vyjadruje Future Continuous: „will be holding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který bude v danou dobu právě probíhat, vyjadřuje Future Continuous: „will be holding“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action in progress at a set future time needs Future Continuous: “will be holding”.

mistakes.text: At nine tonight he will {be hold|holding} ice on {that|the} swelling{ again|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Future Continuous sa tvorí „will be“ + -ing: „will be holding“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Future Continuous se tvoří „will be“ + -ing: „will be holding“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Future Continuous is “will be” + -ing: “will be holding”.

source_issues: SK/CZ have no 'again' (zase/zas); translations without 'again' accepted.
